question: Two circles of radii 18 cm and 10 cm have centers 34 cm apart. Find length of internal common tangent.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of first circle (r₁) = 18 cm

Radius of second circle (r₂) = 10 cm

Distance between centers (d) = 34 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of internal common tangent = √(d² − (r₁ + r₂)²)

**Calculations:**

r₁ + r₂ = 18 + 10 = 28

⇒ d² = 34² = 1156

⇒ (r₁ + r₂)² = 28² = 784

⇒ Length = √(1156 − 784)

⇒ Length = √372

**∴ The length of the internal common tangent is √372 cm.**
